expectations.text: Explicitly frames the pipeline choice as workflow-vs-agent(-vs-multi-agent)
expectations.evidence: "Use a workflow, not a coordinator + sub-agents... this is prompt chaining with a parallelization step."

expectations.text: Cites token/cost overhead of multi-agent orchestration
expectations.evidence: "multi-agent orchestration... runs roughly an order of magnitude more tokens than a single-call/workflow approach."

expectations.text: Ties sub-agent decision to open-ended vs. knowable-in-advance steps
expectations.evidence: "The steps here are knowable ahead of time... When this would flip to multi-agent: if 'do some web research' is actually open-ended"

expectations.text: Recommends STDIO tied to same-machine co-location
expectations.evidence: "STDIO. The deciding fact is co-location: the wiki server and Claude Code run on the same laptop."
